_A_EMPTY_STATE_COMPONENT_DESCRIPTION_: AEmptyState shows that there is no data: an icon, a title, a text and buttons. Use it in tables, lists and trees, e.g. "No entries yet" or "Nothing found".
_A_EMPTY_STATE_PROPS_HEADER_TAG_DESCRIPT: Tag of the title. p by default, so the heading structure of the page stays correct. Set a heading level (e.g. h2, h3) if the empty state is a section of its own. The default can be changed for the whole app with AComponentsPlugin.
_A_EMPTY_STATE_PROPS_ICON_DESCRIPTION_: Icon above the title, a name registered with AIconPlugin. It is decorative and hidden from screen readers.
_A_EMPTY_STATE_PROPS_TEXT_DESCRIPTION_: Text below the title. Accepts a translation key.
_A_EMPTY_STATE_SLOTS_DEFAULT_DESCRIPTION: Buttons or links below the text, e.g. to create the first entry or to reset the filters.
_A_EMPTY_STATE_SLOTS_ICON_DESCRIPTION_: Own content instead of the prop icon, e.g. an illustration. It is hidden from screen readers.
_A_EMPTY_STATE_BASIC_DESCRIPTION_: An empty list with a button for the first entry. header-tag makes the title a heading of the right level. The class a_tile adds a frame.
_A_EMPTY_STATE_EXAMPLE_BASIC_TEXT_: Create the first entry to see it here.
_A_EMPTY_STATE_SEARCH_DESCRIPTION_: The empty state appears when the search has no results. It is inside an element with role="status" that is always in the page, so a screen reader announces it. An element with role="status" that is added together with its content is often not announced. The placeholder {{ search }} comes from extra.
_A_EMPTY_STATE_EXAMPLE_SEARCH_TEXT_: Check the spelling or try a shorter term.
